history.rootBoundary: Temporary workspace session lookup failures escaped as non-JSON server errors.
history.sessionReads: One bounded retry for the two read-only session RPCs; authenticated workspace bound to the request.
history.ui: Read-only history retry and an explicit recovery button preserve the typed message.

quotationScope.default: Only products requested in the customer's actual current email or explicit user selection.
quotationScope.missingNamesAndAmbiguousGrades: Ask for clarification; never silently substitute.
quotationScope.newEmailAttachments: Restricted to the grounded customer selection.
quotationScope.existingSavedAttachments: Use the exact owner-scoped saved quotation with revision and fingerprint checks.
